timing: No builder, corpus, backend output, or result exists.

unit_id.description: Opaque ID derived from contract version, source type, path, locator, and search-text hash. Snapshot commit is excluded so an unchanged unit keeps its ID across historical snapshots. It must not encode time, category, or relevance.

search_text.description: The byte-identical UTF-8 text passed to every retrieval representation before its documented tokenizer.

source_blob_sha256.description: Portable SHA-256 of the exact historical file bytes, distinct from Git's typed object name.

source_aliases.description: Exact duplicate byte sources collapsed before ranking; near duplicates are not collapsed.

backend_visible_fields.description: The primary B1/B2/C1/C2 comparison receives no path, filename, time, status, trust, or label.

query_log_schema.title: PMLAB authentic pre-output query log v0

origin_receipt.description: Public locators may be explicit. Private origins use an independently random receipt or keyed digest whose mapping/key remains outside Git; an unkeyed content or locator hash is forbidden.

pre_output_attestation.const: No candidate backend output or gold evidence search was viewed before this query was frozen.

storage_class.description: Local-restricted query text and origin mappings must not be committed to the public repository; public artifacts expose opaque IDs and aggregate receipts only.

policy_digest.snapshot_rule: enumerate the exact Git tree with git ls-tree -r --full-tree at query_cutoff_commit and read each eligible blob with <commit>:<path>; never read the working tree for a historical snapshot

unitization.stable_unit_id: sha256 over versioned canonical identity containing source_type, path, locator, and search_text_sha256; exclude snapshot_commit so unchanged content keeps one ID across snapshots
unitization.markdown: CommonMark 0.31.2 ATX and Setext heading section with heading-path text plus direct body; child bodies are separate; fenced-code heading lookalikes are not headings; preserve heading path, occurrence, and exact historical line span in the hidden locator
unitization.markdown_preamble: non-empty content before the first heading is one explicit preamble unit
unitization.project_memory: one event per unit from the historical events.jsonl blob; search text uses a frozen allowlist of semantic fields; superseded events remain available for temporal gold and derived active status stays backend-hidden
unitization.catalog_csv: RFC 4180 parse with the historical header; search text serializes header-value pairs in frozen source-column order; malformed or duplicate headers fail closed
unitization.catalog_jsonl: one I-JSON object per line with unique member names; canonical search text follows RFC 8785 JCS and UTF-8; non-I-JSON numbers or duplicate names fail closed
unitization.oversize: split only at deterministic paragraph boundaries under a UTF-8 byte ceiling chosen on development and frozen before test
unitization.exact_duplicates: collapse identical search_text hashes into one ranked unit and preserve every source alias
unitization.near_duplicates: preserve and report; do not tune a similarity deduplicator on test

historical_tree_controls.git_object_format: record sha1 or sha256 from the repository; never infer the algorithm only from an unlabeled digest
historical_tree_controls.portable_blob_integrity: record SHA-256 of exact blob bytes in addition to the Git typed object name
historical_tree_controls.unsupported_action: exclude with a counted reason before unitization; never follow a link into the working tree

query_privacy.public_query: may use an explicit public Git locator receipt
query_privacy.private_query: store verbatim text and origin mapping only in local-restricted storage; publish opaque IDs and aggregate receipts
allowed_private_receipts: keyed digest with key outside Git
query_privacy.attestation_limit: a pre-output statement records process provenance but is not independent proof; capture order must be audited separately

pending_before_execution: freeze UTF-8 byte ceiling on outcome-hidden development
implement and test historical Git-tree reconstruction
independently review stable-ID, heading-context, canonical-row, and query-privacy rules
verify no test query log or label path enters any unit

registered_rules: Historical files come only from the cutoff Git tree, never the working tree.
Unit IDs exclude snapshot commit and include version, type, path, locator, and search-text hash.
Markdown search text contains CommonMark heading path plus direct body; child bodies are separate.
CSV uses historical headers and source order; JSONL requires I-JSON plus RFC 8785 JCS.
Symlinks, gitlinks, binary, non-UTF-8, and malformed rows fail closed.
Unkeyed private-origin hashes are forbidden; private text and mappings stay local-restricted.
Exact duplicates collapse deterministically with aliases; near duplicates remain.
Independent review and label-free size/token feasibility remain required before builder authorization.
authority: M1 advisory only; builder must remain locked.
